block.ssh.model.title: SSH Diagnostics
block.ssh.model.description: Run allowlisted read-only Linux diagnostics on explicitly pinned SSH hosts, with wallet or authorized agent authentication and bounded redacted output.
block.ssh.workflow: Run an approved diagnostic profile on a pinned host. No arbitrary shell, forwarding or automatic retries.
block.ssh.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.ssh.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.ssh.help_enabled: Off by default. Only an executed request connects; Prepare and opening this form never authenticate.
block.ssh.help_hosts: Array of host objects: id, hostname, port, username, host_key_sha256, auth, credential_ref or agent_key_sha256, commands, paths and services. Profiles: system, uptime, memory, disk, processes, service, journal. See the package README for complete examples; never paste private keys here.
block.ssh.help_timeout_sec: Covers connection, authentication and the remote command. Stop closes the local connection; remote process termination cannot be guaranteed.
block.ssh.help_max_output_bytes: If stdout or stderr exceeds this cap, both partial outputs are discarded before publication.
block.ssh.help_redact_emails: Known credentials and credential-like lines are always masked. Pattern matching is not a guarantee of universal anonymization.
block.ssh.help_connect_timeout_sec: Per-stage cap within the total deadline. No automatic retries.
block.ssh.help_agent_socket: Only used by hosts with auth=agent and an exact agent_key_sha256. Empty uses SSH_AUTH_SOCK from the runtime environment; no agent forwarding or implicit key search.
block.ssh.help_redact_secret_refs: Up to eight wallet references containing literal text to redact from both outputs. A locked or missing secret refuses the request before connecting.
